title.zh: 横屏导师照片轮播并精简导师选择
title.en: Add a wide-screen tutor portrait carousel without a duplicate choice row

purpose.zh: 宽屏居中完整显示当前导师照片，两侧露出相邻导师；滑动或点击侧边预览可切换，窄屏保留箭头，并删去重复的导师卡片行。
purpose.en: Center the complete selected tutor portrait, preview adjacent tutors at either side on wide screens, switch by swipe or side-preview click, retain arrows on narrow screens, and remove the redundant tutor row.

zh: 当前导师照片保持原比例、完整居中；宽屏左右各露出相邻导师的半幅预览。
可左右滑动照片或点侧边预览切换导师；宽屏隐藏箭头，窄屏保留；通话期间锁定。
删除照片下方重复的导师卡片行，缩短手机页面。
en: Keep the current tutor portrait complete and centered at its natural ratio, with half-visible adjacent previews on wide screens.
Switch tutors by swiping or selecting a side preview; hide arrows when side previews fit, retain them on narrow screens, and lock selection during calls.
Remove the duplicate tutor-card row below the photo to shorten mobile pages.

zh: 旗舰版实时导师照片选择界面；不改通话、导师偏好、账户或付款。
en: The Max live tutor portrait selection UI; no changes to calls, preferences, accounts, or payments.

zh: 复用现有三张照片和偏好保存接口，在固定高度照片区域加入当前导师与左右相邻导师预览。
照片触控滑动和侧边预览按钮调用现有导师切换逻辑；宽屏按容器宽度显示预览并隐藏箭头，窄屏沿用箭头；通话时全部禁用。
移除重复的导师选择栏及其样式，保留照片、字幕和通话按钮布局。
en: Reuse the three existing portraits and preference endpoint in a bounded-height stage with centered selection and adjacent previews.
Map touch swipes and side-preview buttons to the existing tutor-switch logic; use container width to swap wide previews for narrow-screen arrows, and disable selection during calls.
Remove the redundant tutor-selector row and its styles while preserving captions and call actions.

zh: 站点策略门禁、TypeScript、零警告 lint、全套测试、构建与中英文 WebKit 响应式检查。
发布后实测桌面和手机下照片比例、轮播与通话锁定，并核对精确 Project 发布记录。
en: Site policy gates, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, build, and Chinese/English responsive WebKit checks.
After deployment, inspect wide and phone portrait ratios, carousel selection and in-call lock, then verify the exact Project release record.

zh: 无付款、账户或实时语音行为变更。
en: No payment, account, or live-voice behavior changes.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 的十三个界面语言、学习语言和现有导师照片。
en: Preserve SmartLingo's thirteen interface locales, learning-language selection, and existing tutor photos.

rollback.zh: 回退到上一部署提交；数据库无变更。
rollback.en: Deploy the prior commit; no database change is involved.
